integration_issues.issue: During mutating UI flows, app intermittently redirects from Rapid screen to entry sign-in with banner 'Your session ended. Sign in again.' before/while card interactions. Console shows repeated 401s on unrelated /api/jl/* prefetch endpoints, followed by auth-loss behavior.

integration_issues.issue: To keep fixture session alive in browser automation, /api/jl/auth/refresh had to be intercepted in addition to auth/session, auth/me, /rf/access; otherwise unrelated JL prefetch 401s trigger sign-out and abort RF UI flow.

action_items: Investigate frontend auth-loss cascade: unrelated JL 401 prefetch calls should not invalidate an active RF fixture/canonical session during Rapid gameplay.
Stabilize RF UI test harness contract so mutating flows can proceed without intercepting extra auth refresh endpoint.

After auth-loss fix, rerun full requested mobile UI scope: solo timeout+skip+diagram screenshots, duel invite/join two-view progression, history tap read-only verification, and shop purchase/equip/insufficient via UI.

rca_of_issue: RCA: In web preview, non-RF JL calls (pyq/streak/exam-navigation/etc.) return 401 under local fixture auth because canonical cookie jar is not truly established for those paths. API client treats these 401s as refreshable and may trigger auth-loss, clearing user state and returning to entry screen. This interrupts Rapid mutating UI before solo/duel completion. Mitigation: prevent unrelated 401 prefetch calls from cascading into global auth-loss during RF fixture runs, or provide a fully valid canonical session cookie path for fixture mode.
